predecessors.name: Goryeo
predecessors.text: Dongnyeong: '60 prefectures and cities in northwest part of Goryeo', cut to the land the goryeo keyframes hold (same outline as the goryeo dossier's 1270 loss)

successors.name: Goryeo
successors.text: Dongnyeong: '60 prefectures and cities in northwest part of Goryeo', cut to the land the goryeo keyframes hold (same outline as the goryeo dossier's 1270 loss)

ledger.x: 1269: Ch'oe T'an's rebels hand the north-west to the Yuan.
1270: the rebels' land becomes a Yuan prefecture.
July 1290: Dongnyeong goes back to Goryeo.

wars.name: Ch'oe T'an's rebellion
wars.outcome: Ch'oe T'an's revolt against Im Yŏn gives the north-west to the Yuan; Goryeo regains it in 1290.

certainty.note: Jabi Pass is the only edge the page names.
